what: Stage B4 drive-backoff probe: uniform (s=1) dolfinx hold-out peak at candidate drives, to pick the backed-off drive whose uniform peak sits a few C UNDER T_eff so the AL has a feasible region to shape up into. Peaks are MEASURED via stage_b.uniform_holdout_peak (the same arbiter the AL restoration shift reads).
rule: pick the HIGHEST drive whose uniform peak is in-band (~228-232), leaving AL room to shape UP toward T_eff=235 while staying feasible
